# Components

<!-- Generated by generate-indexes.mjs; edit contracts, then regenerate. -->

- **Badge**
  - Description: Annotate an item with a concise status, category or count while the reader scans a list or a header. Static display: a Badge never initiates an action and never holds a body longer than one line.
  - Contract: [contract](components/badge.md)

- **Button**
  - Description: Invoke one immediate action, submit one form or navigate to one destination through a native button or link. The variant carries the action's consequence: destructive for state-destroying actions, outline or secondary for lower-priority ones, ghost for toolbars and dense rows.
  - Contract: [contract](components/button.md)

- **Card**
  - Description: Group related content into one bordered, raised surface with a header, an optional action corner, a body and a footer. A Card is a layout contract for a self-contained block, not a popover and not a page section divider.
  - Contract: [contract](components/card.md)

- **Checkbox**
  - Description: Let the user set one boolean state that belongs to a form or to a row selection, with an explicit checked, unchecked and (when used) indeterminate state. The state changes on click and stays until the next click.
  - Contract: [contract](components/checkbox.md)

- **Command**
  - Description: Let the user find and run one action from a searchable, keyboard-first list: command palettes, pickers over a known set, quick filters. Text input narrows the list; selection runs the action.
  - Contract: [contract](components/command.md)

- **Dialog**
  - Description: Hold the user's attention on one task that must finish or be cancelled explicitly before the page continues: confirmations, detail inspection, forms. A Dialog blocks the page behind an overlay until it closes.
  - Contract: [contract](components/dialog.md)

- **Dropdown menu**
  - Description: Offer a list of actions or settings behind one trigger, opened on click and closed on selection. A Dropdown menu holds actions; it is not a form surface and not a view switcher.
  - Contract: [contract](components/dropdown-menu.md)

- **Input**
  - Description: Collect one line of text the user types, for a form field, a filter box or an inline edit. One input owns one value; composition, validation and the label stay with the consumer.
  - Contract: [contract](components/input.md)

- **Popover**
  - Description: Show anchored, non-blocking content next to a trigger until the user dismisses it: filters, pickers, detail summaries. The page stays usable; the popover floats above it and closes on outside interaction.
  - Contract: [contract](components/popover.md)

- **Separator**
  - Description: Mark the boundary between two groups of content with a hairline, horizontal or vertical, inside one composition. A Separator divides; it never carries content and never collapses sections.
  - Contract: [contract](components/separator.md)

- **Table**
  - Description: Present tabular data with native table semantics: header, body, optional footer and caption, row hover and selection states. The Table renders what the consumer hands it; sorting, selection and virtualization stay with the caller.
  - Contract: [contract](components/table.md)

- **Tabs**
  - Description: Switch between sibling views of one context when only one view is visible at a time. Tabs keep the context's identity stable while its content changes; they do not paginate and they do not navigate between screens.
  - Contract: [contract](components/tabs.md)

- **Tooltip**
  - Description: Name a control or show one short hint on hover or keyboard focus, without interaction of its own. A Tooltip says what the control is; it never carries actions or form content.
  - Contract: [contract](components/tooltip.md)
